name: Easy Picadillo-Inspired Beef Casserole with Zucchini, Olives, Raisins & Chipotle Potato Topping

instructions.primary_message: Place water in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, add instant mashed potatoes and stir until mash is smooth and combined. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cups water
2 (113 g) pkg instant mashed potatoes, "homestyle" flavor

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add onion, beef, garlic, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g lean ground beef
2 tsp minced garlic
1 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp cinnamon, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, mince 2 chipotle peppers. Add to the pot with the mashed potatoes, along with 1 tbsp adobo sauce from the can. Stir to combine and set aside. (Reserve remaining chipotles for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (198 g) can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and small dice zucchini. Roughly chop olives. Transfer both to a large casserole dish, then add cooked beef, tomatoes, raisins, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer. Spread chipotle mashed potatoes over the casserole and tightly cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
¼ cup green olives, pimiento-stuffed
1 (411 g) can diced tomatoes
¼ cup raisins
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place casserole in the oven and bake until warmed through and filling is bubbling, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly, 5 minutes.
To serve, divide casserole between plates or bowls and enjoy!
